title: TPU gas joints · original valve heads

layout.comparison_y_placement: Rear fittings seated in the common 6mm panel, water inlet straight to ASSE, gas drop registered to the fixed core guide
layout.pcb_orientation: Flat on its back, components upward, near the front of the cold core
layout.relay_service: PCB is forward of the relays and supply; no PCB removal for their terminal tool columns
layout.water_header_poses: Rigid group29mm fore; original valve head rotations and all fitting axes retained
layout.planned_funnel_minus_y_expansion: Future funnel shape to be considered with the PCB below its current bowl
layout.psu_orientation: Flat on its back, AC aft and DC fore, screws upward
layout.psu_mount_service: Fasten supply before the rear inlet/data parts covering its rear mounting axes
layout.connection_scope: Ten active JST plugs and their local wire bends, J10 power leads and selected PSU/relay local conductors; separate unplugging and screwdriver probes
layout.context_scope: Selected water and CO2 assemblies, dry electronics with local leads, funnel/frame and native walls/roof; WAGOs deferred, V-B and reservoir routes set aside
layout.wago_placement: Place junctions last, after primary components and wire routes, where connections are needed
layout.co2_flow: Rear bulkhead → threadless TPU inlet cuff → WR regulator → directly threaded Gasher check → TPU90°outlet cuff → continuous tube to core
layout.deferred_connections: Soda, vent and flavor ports show local departures; full onward routes are not placed
layout.pcb_lead_dressing: J7 bends inward over the board; other local lead choices follow their carried models
layout.co2_clamps: Four9mm closed bands on the two metal cuffs and two tube sockets

metrics.scope: All selected installed bodies, TPU joints and bands, tubes, local wires, bare nuts and native wall/roof context; intended mates excluded
metrics.limits: TPU metal cuffs, clamp occupancy and local tube dressing are estimates. Full onward soda/vent/flavor and complete wire routes are outside this selected arrangement.
